name: delete_symbol_action_on_a_used_master_asks_first
note: actions.yaml delete_symbol_action: a master with live instances (symbol_usage > 0) is not deleted; the delete_symbol_orphan_confirm dialog opens instead and the document is unchanged. new_symbol mints the master 01234567, leaves its instance in place, and selects the master in the Symbols panel (its own set_panel_state). The panel_state seed's VALUE does not matter (new_symbol overwrites it; a seed of an unknown id survives as a mutant): it stands for the Symbols panel being open, because the Mac store route drops a set_panel_state on a panel scope that was never initialized, and the runner initializes one only for a seeded panel. The delete runs in that panel's scope, as its button does.
